summary.text: William Soules is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2013, representing District 37 in Doña Ana County.
Soules chairs the Senate Education Committee and is vice chair of the Senate Indian, Rural and Cultural Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Soules's occupation as teacher.
Between sessions, Soules chairs the Legislative Education Study Committee and is vice chair of the Public School Capital Outlay Oversight Task Force.
